label.name: UCLA label
label.description: UCLA Heat Maps estimated excess ER visits per 10,000 residents, CalHeatScore level 4 layer, total over May-October 2008-2018
label.unit: excess ER visits per 10,000 residents (total, May-Oct 2008-2018)

oof.name: LA out-of-fold
oof.description: Each ZIP is predicted by a model trained on the other four spatial folds of LA County (heat level 4 only). 15 inputs: 10 corrected CalEnviroScreen inputs and population density, plus 4 ACS 2014-2018 features (Part 2).

holdout.name: LA holdout
holdout.description: Every LA ZIP is predicted by one model trained on all California ZIPs outside LA County (heat levels 1-4, 12 inputs, corrected CalEnviroScreen); level-4 predictions shown (Part 1).

error_definition: error = prediction - UCLA label; positive = overprediction, negative = underprediction; same unit as the label
status: Final versions at integration: corrected CalEnviroScreen inputs (-999 treated as missing).
